id-20260826-news-2.title: Forest and Land Fire Haze in Kalimantan Thickens, BMKG Detects Hundreds of New Hotspots Ahead of Late August

segments.src: Kondisi kabut asap akibat kebakaran hutan dan lahan (karhutla) di sejumlah wilayah Kalimantan dilaporkan semakin pekat menjelang akhir Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The haze condition caused by forest and land fires (karhutla) in several regions of Kalimantan is reported to be increasingly thick ahead of late August 2026.

segments.src: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG) mencatat penambahan ratusan titik panas baru yang tersebar di Sumatera dan Kalimantan, seiring musim kemarau yang masih berlangsung di sebagian besar wilayah Indonesia.
segments.tr: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) recorded the addition of hundreds of new hotspots spread across Sumatra and Kalimantan, along with the dry season still occurring in most parts of Indonesia.

segments.src: ## Titik Panas Bertambah di Sumatera dan Kalimantan
segments.tr: ## Hotspots Increase in Sumatra and Kalimantan

segments.src: Berdasarkan pemantauan satelit yang dihimpun BMKG, jumlah titik panas (hotspot) di dua pulau besar tersebut menunjukkan tren peningkatan dalam beberapa hari terakhir.
segments.tr: Based on satellite monitoring compiled by BMKG, the number of hotspots on the two large islands has shown an increasing trend in recent days.

segments.src: Titik-titik panas ini umumnya terdeteksi di area lahan gambut dan kawasan perkebunan yang rentan terbakar saat musim kering.
segments.tr: These hotspots are generally detected in peatland areas and plantation regions that are vulnerable to burning during the dry season.

segments.src: Pihak berwenang mengimbau masyarakat dan pelaku usaha di sekitar area rawan untuk tidak melakukan pembakaran lahan, mengingat kondisi cuaca kering dapat mempercepat penyebaran api.
segments.tr: Authorities have urged the public and business actors around vulnerable areas not to burn land, considering that dry weather conditions can accelerate the spread of fire.

segments.src: BMKG juga mengingatkan bahwa arah dan kecepatan angin turut memengaruhi sebaran asap ke wilayah permukiman, termasuk kemungkinan dampak lintas wilayah yang perlu diwaspadai bersama.
segments.tr: BMKG also reminded that wind direction and speed also affect the spread of smoke to residential areas, including the possibility of cross-regional impacts that need to be watched out for together.

segments.src: ## Jarak Pandang Menurun, Aktivitas di Banjarbaru Terganggu
segments.tr: ## Visibility Drops, Activities in Banjarbaru Disrupted

segments.src: Di Banjarbaru, Kalimantan Selatan, kabut asap yang pekat dilaporkan sempat menurunkan jarak pandang secara signifikan, terutama pada pagi hari.
segments.tr: In Banjarbaru, South Kalimantan, the thick haze was reported to have significantly reduced visibility, especially in the morning.

segments.src: Kondisi ini disebut-sebut turut berkontribusi pada insiden kecelakaan lalu lintas beruntun di ruas jalan setempat, meski penyebab pasti kecelakaan tetap perlu dikonfirmasi lebih lanjut oleh pihak kepolisian lalu lintas setempat.
segments.tr: This condition is said to have contributed to a multiple traffic accident incident on local roads, although the exact cause of the accident still needs to be further confirmed by the local traffic police.

segments.src: Selain berdampak pada lalu lintas, penurunan kualitas udara dan jarak pandang juga dilaporkan memengaruhi aktivitas belajar-mengajar di sejumlah sekolah.
segments.tr: In addition to impacting traffic, the decline in air quality and visibility was also reported to affect teaching and learning activities in several schools.

segments.src: Beberapa satuan pendidikan disebut mempertimbangkan penyesuaian jadwal atau metode belajar sebagai langkah antisipasi demi keselamatan dan kesehatan siswa.
segments.tr: Several educational units are said to be considering schedule adjustments or learning methods as an anticipatory step for the safety and health of students.

segments.src: ## Imbauan bagi Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Appeal to the Public

segments.src: Menghadapi situasi ini, warga di wilayah terdampak diimbau untuk:
segments.tr: Facing this situation, residents in affected areas are urged to:

segments.src: - Membatasi aktivitas di luar ruangan, terutama saat kabut asap terlihat tebal.
segments.tr: - Limit outdoor activities, especially when the haze appears thick.

segments.src: - Menggunakan masker yang sesuai standar saat beraktivitas di luar rumah.
segments.tr: - Use standard-compliant masks when doing activities outside the house.

segments.src: - Memantau informasi kualitas udara dan titik panas melalui kanal resmi BMKG maupun instansi lingkungan hidup setempat.
segments.tr: - Monitor air quality and hotspot information through official BMKG channels as well as local environmental agencies.

segments.src: - Berhati-hati saat berkendara pada kondisi jarak pandang terbatas, termasuk menyalakan lampu kendaraan dan mengurangi kecepatan.
segments.tr: - Be careful when driving in limited visibility conditions, including turning on vehicle lights and reducing speed.

segments.src: - Segera memeriksakan diri ke fasilitas kesehatan apabila mengalami gangguan pernapasan.
segments.tr: - Immediately check yourself at health facilities if you experience respiratory problems.

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah bersama instansi terkait dilaporkan terus melakukan pemantauan dan upaya pemadaman di titik-titik kebakaran, termasuk koordinasi dengan tim pemadam kebakaran dan potensi dukungan modifikasi cuaca apabila diperlukan.
segments.tr: Local governments together with related agencies are reported to continue monitoring and extinguishing efforts at fire points, including coordination with fire fighting teams and potential weather modification support if needed.

segments.src: ## Perlu Kewaspadaan Bersama
segments.tr: ## Mutual Vigilance Needed

segments.src: Kondisi kabut asap karhutla merupakan persoalan tahunan yang kerap muncul saat puncak musim kemarau, khususnya di wilayah dengan lahan gambut yang luas.
segments.tr: The forest fire haze condition is an annual issue that often arises during the peak of the dry season, especially in areas with extensive peatlands.

segments.src: Kewaspadaan dan kedisiplinan dalam menjaga lahan agar tidak terbakar, baik secara sengaja maupun akibat kelalaian, menjadi kunci untuk mencegah situasi semakin memburuk.
segments.tr: Vigilance and discipline in protecting land so that it does not burn, either intentionally or due to negligence, are the keys to preventing the situation from getting worse.

segments.src: Masyarakat diharapkan tetap memantau perkembangan informasi resmi dari BMKG serta instansi pemerintah daerah agar dapat mengambil langkah antisipasi yang tepat demi keselamatan bersama.
segments.tr: The public is expected to continue monitoring official information developments from BMKG and local government agencies in order to take appropriate anticipatory steps for mutual safety.

id-20260826-news-3.title: Freeport Accelerates Manyar Smelter Operation in Gresik to Late August, Boosts National Copper Supply

segments.src: PT Freeport Indonesia (PTFI) dikabarkan mempercepat jadwal pengoperasian kembali fasilitas smelter tembaga barunya di kawasan Manyar, Gresik, Jawa Timur.
segments.tr: PT Freeport Indonesia (PTFI) is reportedly accelerating the restart schedule of its new copper smelter facility in the Manyar area, Gresik, East Java.

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, target pengoperasian yang semula direncanakan pada waktu berikutnya kini dimajukan menjadi akhir Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, the operation target originally planned for a later time has now been moved up to the end of August 2026.

segments.src: Langkah ini disebut-sebut sebagai respons cepat perusahaan untuk menjaga kelangsungan pasokan tembaga olahan di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: This step is widely described as the company's swift response to maintain the continuity of refined copper supply domestically.

segments.src: ## Latar Belakang Percepatan
segments.tr: ## Background of the Acceleration

segments.src: Percepatan ini muncul menyusul terhentinya operasional smelter lama milik PT Smelting sejak awal bulan.
segments.tr: This acceleration comes following the suspension of operations at PT Smelting's older facility since the beginning of the month.

segments.src: PT Smelting selama ini dikenal sebagai salah satu fasilitas pengolahan dan pemurnian (smelter) konsentrat tembaga tertua di Indonesia yang berlokasi di Gresik, Jawa Timur.
segments.tr: PT Smelting has long been known as one of the oldest copper concentrate processing and refining facilities (smelters) in Indonesia, located in Gresik, East Java.

segments.src: Terhentinya aktivitas produksi di fasilitas tersebut berpotensi menimbulkan kekhawatiran terhadap kestabilan pasokan katoda tembaga bagi industri manufaktur dan elektronik nasional yang bergantung pada bahan baku olahan dalam negeri.
segments.tr: The cessation of production activities at the facility has the potential to raise concerns regarding the stability of copper cathode supply for the national manufacturing and electronics industries that depend on domestic processed raw materials.

segments.src: Sebagai bagian dari ekosistem hilirisasi mineral yang didorong pemerintah, keberadaan smelter tembaga di dalam negeri dinilai penting untuk memastikan nilai tambah dari sumber daya mineral tidak sepenuhnya lari ke luar negeri.
segments.tr: As part of the mineral downstreaming ecosystem promoted by the government, the presence of a domestic copper smelter is considered crucial to ensure that the added value of mineral resources does not entirely flow abroad.

segments.src: Smelter Manyar sendiri merupakan salah satu proyek hilirisasi tembaga berskala besar yang telah lama dinantikan rampung dan beroperasi penuh.
segments.tr: The Manyar Smelter itself is one of the large-scale copper downstreaming projects that has long been awaited for completion and full operation.

segments.src: ## Fokus pada Ketahanan Pasokan Domestik
segments.tr: ## Focus on Domestic Supply Resilience

segments.src: Dengan mempercepat pengoperasian smelter Manyar, manajemen PTFI disebut ingin memastikan rantai pasok tembaga olahan nasional tidak mengalami gangguan berarti akibat kekosongan produksi dari fasilitas yang lebih dulu berhenti beroperasi.
segments.tr: By accelerating the operation of the Manyar smelter, PTFI's management is said to want to ensure that the national refined copper supply chain does not experience significant disruptions due to production vacuums from the facility that stopped operating earlier.

segments.src: Upaya ini juga dipandang sejalan dengan komitmen perusahaan terhadap program hilirisasi mineral yang menjadi salah satu agenda strategis di sektor pertambangan dan energi nasional.
segments.tr: This effort is also seen as aligned with the company's commitment to the mineral downstreaming program, which is one of the strategic agendas in the national mining and energy sector.

segments.src: Sejumlah pemangku kepentingan di industri berharap percepatan ini dapat meminimalkan dampak terhadap harga maupun ketersediaan bahan baku tembaga bagi industri turunan, seperti kabel, komponen elektronik, hingga peralatan kelistrikan yang banyak menyerap produk tembaga olahan dalam negeri.
segments.tr: Several industry stakeholders hope this acceleration can minimize the impact on the price and availability of copper raw materials for derivative industries, such as cables, electronic components, and electrical equipment that heavily absorb domestic refined copper products.

segments.src: ## Tantangan Operasional
segments.tr: ## Operational Challenges

segments.src: Meski demikian, mempercepat jadwal pengoperasian sebuah fasilitas smelter berskala besar bukan tanpa tantangan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, accelerating the operation schedule of a large-scale smelter facility is not without its challenges.

segments.src: Proses commissioning, pengujian peralatan, hingga pemenuhan standar keselamatan dan lingkungan umumnya membutuhkan waktu dan ketelitian tinggi agar operasional dapat berjalan optimal dan aman dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: The commissioning process, equipment testing, and fulfillment of safety and environmental standards generally require time and high precision so that operations can run optimally and safely in the long term.

segments.src: Publik dan pemangku kepentingan diharapkan tetap menantikan konfirmasi resmi dari perusahaan maupun otoritas terkait mengenai kesiapan penuh fasilitas tersebut sebelum beroperasi secara komersial.
segments.tr: The public and stakeholders are expected to continue awaiting official confirmation from the company and related authorities regarding the full readiness of the facility before it operates commercially.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Industri dan Ekonomi Nasional
segments.tr: ## Impact on the National Industry and Economy

segments.src: Jika rencana ini terealisasi sesuai target, kehadiran smelter Manyar yang beroperasi lebih awal berpotensi memberikan sejumlah manfaat, di antaranya:
segments.tr: If this plan is realized according to target, the presence of the Manyar smelter operating earlier has the potential to provide several benefits, including:

segments.src: - Menjaga stabilitas pasokan tembaga olahan bagi industri dalam negeri.
segments.tr: - Maintaining the stability of refined copper supply for the domestic industry.

segments.src: - Mendukung program hilirisasi mineral yang menjadi prioritas kebijakan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: - Supporting the mineral downstreaming program which is a priority of national economic policy.

segments.src: - Berpotensi membuka lapangan kerja tambahan di sektor pengolahan mineral, khususnya di kawasan industri Gresik.
segments.tr: - Potentially opening additional jobs in the mineral processing sector, especially in the Gresik industrial area.

segments.src: - Memperkuat posisi Indonesia sebagai salah satu produsen tembaga olahan di kawasan.
segments.tr: - Strengthening Indonesia's position as one of the producers of refined copper in the region.

segments.src: Perkembangan lebih lanjut mengenai kesiapan operasional dan hasil produksi awal dari smelter Manyar akan terus dipantau oleh berbagai pihak, mengingat besarnya peran fasilitas ini dalam menopang kebutuhan tembaga nasional ke depan.
segments.tr: Further developments regarding operational readiness and initial production results from the Manyar smelter will continue to be monitored by various parties, given the magnitude of this facility's role in supporting future national copper needs.

segments.src: Masyarakat dan pelaku industri disarankan untuk terus mengikuti informasi resmi dari PT Freeport Indonesia maupun kementerian terkait guna mendapatkan kepastian jadwal dan kapasitas produksi yang sesungguhnya.
segments.tr: The public and industry players are advised to keep following official information from PT Freeport Indonesia and related ministries to obtain certainty regarding the actual schedule and production capacity.

id-20260826-news-1.title: August 27, 2026 Demonstration in Front of the DPR Building: Diverse Demands, from the Asset Forfeiture Bill to the Sustainability of the Free Nutritious Meal Program

segments.src: Sejumlah elemen masyarakat, termasuk aliansi mahasiswa dan kelompok sipil, dikabarkan bersiap menggelar aksi unjuk rasa di depan Gedung DPR/MPR RI pada 27 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: A number of societal elements, including student alliances and civil groups, are reportedly preparing to hold a demonstration in front of the DPR/MPR RI Building on August 27, 2026.

segments.src: Berbeda dari aksi-aksi sebelumnya yang biasanya mengusung satu isu utama, rencana aksi kali ini disebut-sebut akan diwarnai beragam tuntutan yang datang dari kelompok dengan kepentingan berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: Unlike previous actions that usually carried one main issue, the planned action this time is said to be colored by various demands coming from groups with different interests.

segments.src: ## Desakan Percepatan RUU Perampasan Aset
segments.tr: ## Urging the Acceleration of the Asset Forfeiture Bill

segments.src: Salah satu isu yang mengemuka adalah desakan agar DPR segera membahas dan mengesahkan Rancangan Undang-Undang (RUU) Perampasan Aset.
segments.tr: One of the issues emerging is the demand for the DPR to immediately discuss and pass the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset).

segments.src: Rancangan ini sudah lama dinantikan sebagian kalangan sebagai instrumen hukum untuk mempermudah negara menyita aset hasil tindak pidana korupsi, termasuk pada kasus-kasus yang pelakunya sulit dijerat secara pidana.
segments.tr: This bill has long been awaited by some circles as a legal instrument to make it easier for the state to seize assets resulting from corruption, including in cases where the perpetrators are difficult to prosecute criminally.

segments.src: Kelompok yang mendorong isu ini juga disebut turut menyuarakan wacana hukuman yang lebih berat bagi terpidana korupsi sebagai bagian dari upaya memperkuat efek jera.
segments.tr: Groups pushing for this issue are also said to be voicing discourse on heavier penalties for corruption convicts as part of efforts to strengthen the deterrent effect.

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, pembahasan RUU tersebut di parlemen memang dikenal berjalan lambat dan kerap tertunda dari periode ke periode.
segments.tr: Until now, the discussion of the bill in parliament is indeed known to be slow and often delayed from period to period.

segments.src: Kalangan yang mendesak percepatan pengesahan menilai keberadaan payung hukum ini penting untuk mengoptimalkan pengembalian kerugian negara.
segments.tr: Those urging for the acceleration of its passage believe the existence of this legal umbrella is important to optimize the recovery of state losses.

segments.src: ## Evaluasi Kebijakan yang Dinilai Memperlebar Ketimpangan
segments.tr: ## Evaluation of Policies Considered to Widen Inequality

segments.src: Selain isu perampasan aset, sebagian peserta aksi disebut membawa tuntutan yang lebih luas, yakni desakan evaluasi terhadap sejumlah kebijakan ekonomi dan sosial yang menurut mereka berpotensi memperlebar jurang ketimpangan antara kelompok masyarakat mampu dan tidak mampu.
segments.tr: Besides the asset forfeiture issue, some participants of the action are said to be bringing broader demands, namely the demand for an evaluation of a number of economic and social policies that they believe have the potential to widen the gap of inequality between the affluent and the less fortunate groups.

segments.src: Isu ini biasanya mencakup topik seperti daya beli masyarakat, lapangan kerja, hingga distribusi anggaran pembangunan antarwilayah.
segments.tr: This issue usually covers topics such as public purchasing power, employment, and the distribution of development budgets between regions.

segments.src: Tuntutan semacam ini kerap muncul dalam berbagai aksi publik sebagai bentuk kontrol sosial terhadap kebijakan pemerintah dan legislatif, dan lazim disampaikan melalui mekanisme demokratis seperti unjuk rasa maupun audiensi dengan wakil rakyat.
segments.tr: Demands of this kind often appear in various public actions as a form of social control over government and legislative policies, and are commonly conveyed through democratic mechanisms such as demonstrations or audiences with people's representatives.

segments.src: ## Dukungan untuk Keberlanjutan Program Makan Bergizi Gratis
segments.tr: ## Support for the Sustainability of the Free Nutritious Meal Program

segments.src: Di sisi lain, ada pula kelompok masyarakat yang dikabarkan akan turun dengan sikap berbeda, yaitu menyuarakan dukungan terhadap keberlanjutan program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG).
segments.tr: On the other hand, there are also community groups reportedly coming down with a different stance, namely voicing support for the sustainability of the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program.

segments.src: Program yang menyasar pemenuhan gizi anak sekolah dan kelompok rentan ini dinilai sejumlah pihak telah memberi manfaat langsung bagi masyarakat, sehingga mereka berharap program tetap dilanjutkan dan bahkan diperluas cakupannya.
segments.tr: The program, which targets the nutritional fulfillment of school children and vulnerable groups, is considered by a number of parties to have provided direct benefits to the community, so they hope the program will be continued and even expanded in its scope.

segments.src: Kehadiran kelompok pendukung MBG di tengah aksi yang didominasi tuntutan kritis menunjukkan bahwa dinamika opini publik terkait kebijakan pemerintah tidak tunggal, melainkan mencerminkan keberagaman pandangan di masyarakat.
segments.tr: The presence of the MBG support group in the midst of an action dominated by critical demands shows that the dynamics of public opinion regarding government policy are not singular, but reflect the diversity of views in society.

segments.src: ## Antisipasi Keamanan
segments.tr: ## Security Anticipation

segments.src: Menjelang pelaksanaan aksi, aparat kepolisian umumnya akan melakukan langkah-langkah antisipasi standar seperti pengaturan lalu lintas di sekitar kawasan Gedung DPR dan koordinasi dengan pihak penyelenggara aksi agar unjuk rasa berlangsung tertib dan damai.
segments.tr: Ahead of the action, the police generally will take standard anticipatory steps such as traffic management around the DPR Building area and coordination with the action organizers so that the demonstration proceeds in an orderly and peaceful manner.

segments.src: Masyarakat yang beraktivitas di sekitar kawasan Senayan dan jalur menuju Gedung DPR diimbau untuk memantau informasi lalu lintas terkini guna menghindari kepadatan.
segments.tr: People conducting activities around the Senayan area and the routes leading to the DPR Building are advised to monitor the latest traffic information to avoid congestion.

segments.src: Sebagai catatan, jadwal, jumlah massa, serta rincian tuntutan dapat berubah menjelang hari pelaksanaan, tergantung dinamika koordinasi antarkelompok yang terlibat.
segments.tr: As a note, the schedule, number of masses, and details of the demands may change closer to the day of implementation, depending on the coordination dynamics between the groups involved.

segments.src: Publik disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan informasi dari sumber resmi maupun pemberitaan media menjelang tanggal aksi.
segments.tr: The public is advised to continue monitoring information developments from official sources and media reports leading up to the date of the action.

segments.src: Terlepas dari perbedaan tuntutan yang dibawa, aksi semacam ini merupakan bagian dari mekanisme demokrasi yang dijamin konstitusi, di mana warga negara berhak menyampaikan pendapat secara terbuka dan damai kepada wakil rakyat maupun pemerintah.
segments.tr: Regardless of the differences in the demands brought, such actions are part of the democratic mechanism guaranteed by the constitution, where citizens have the right to express their opinions openly and peacefully to people's representatives and the government.
